description_en: Adds or removes API products in bulk under a specified product category. The path parameter specifies the category ID, the action in the request body specifies the operation direction, and productIds specifies the list of API product IDs to process. The response returns only the requestId, code, and message, and does not return item-by-item processing results
description_zh: 在指定的产品类别下批量添加或移除 API 产品：路径参数给出类别 ID，请求体的 action 给出本次操作的方向，productIds 给出要处理的 API 产品 ID 列表。响应只返回 requestId、code 与 message，不返回逐条处理结果
kebab_example: aliyun apig update-category-products --category-id category-xxxxxxxx --action action-xxxxxxxx --product-ids product-xxxxxxxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateCategoryProducts

parameters.help_en: The product category ID, which specifies the API products to add or remove. Product categories are created by CreateProductCategory, can be queried by ListProductCategories, and use the same /himarket/v1/product-categories/{categoryId} identifier as GetProductCategory, UpdateProductCategory, and DeleteProductCategory
parameters.help_zh: 产品类别 ID，指定要添加或移除哪些 API 产品。产品类别由 CreateProductCategory 创建，可由 ListProductCategories 查询，与 GetProductCategory、UpdateProductCategory、DeleteProductCategory 使用同一个 /himarket/v1/product-categories/{categoryId} 标识
parameters.name: category_id

parameters.help_en: The direction of this bulk operation: adds the API products specified in productIds to the category, or removes these API products from the category. The set of valid values is not declared in the API definition
parameters.help_zh: 本次批量操作的方向：把 productIds 中的 API 产品加入该类别，或把该类别下的这些 API 产品移除。取值集合未在接口定义中声明
parameters.name: action

parameters.help_en: The list of API product IDs to process. Each element is a primary ID of the API product resource
parameters.help_zh: 要处理的 API 产品 ID 列表，元素为 API 产品资源 Product 的一级 ID
parameters.name: product_ids

v1_parameters.help_en: The product category ID, which specifies the API products to add or remove. Product categories are created by CreateProductCategory, can be queried by ListProductCategories, and use the same /himarket/v1/product-categories/{categoryId} identifier as GetProductCategory, UpdateProductCategory, and DeleteProductCategory

v1_parameters.name: categoryId
